head: sb
title: WhereTheyAskIt_phone_storybook
transcript: Does it fit? When will it come? Can I send it back? Your answers? Buried in an FAQ? Move them next to the Buy button. Not just a size chart. A decision. Runs true to size. Between sizes? Go up. Not fast shipping. Arrives by Friday. And one line on returns. Answer the question where they ask it. Comment STORE.
